findings.body: When Compose merges this overlay with the base service, it keeps the base service's `command` (or the image CMD `["mongod"]`) and appends it to the new `entrypoint`. The list already ends in `"mongod"`, so the Python shim receives `mongod` twice. If the shim forwards its arguments to `mongod`, MongoDB will reject the second positional `mongod` and fail to start. Drop the third list item and let the existing CMD/command supply the executable argument, or set `command` explicitly if the shim requires it.
findings.title: Remove hard-coded mongod arg that duplicates image CMD

value.summary: The overlay adds a GLIBC tunable and a Python shim to work around MongoDB's kernel check, but the new entrypoint duplicates the existing command argument, so the shim will likely start mongod with an extra `mongod` argument and fail to bring up the database.
